item.title: Husband murders Ocala wife, 4-year-old daughter before taking own life
item.description: An "estranged" husband who killed his wife and her four-year-old daughter in their Ocala condominium on Tuesday night, took his own life hours later, after police tracked him across state lines and attempted to conduct a traffic stop. Read more: Husband murders Ocala wife, 4-year-old daughter before taking own life

item.title: Woman struck by horse at barrel racing event sues World Equestrian Center
item.description: A woman has filed a lawsuit against the World Equestrian Center (WEC), an event organizer, and a horse rider, claiming she was severely injured when a horse allegedly stampeded through a chute at an "unmanageable speed" during a competition and threw her into the air. Read more: Woman struck by horse at barrel racing event sues World Equestrian Center

item.title: Is anyone else upset with U.S. Congressman Randy Fine’s proposal for Greenland?
item.description: "Is it just me, but isn't anyone else piping mad about the Greenland Annexation and Statehood Act which was recently introducted by Congressman Randy Fine? So the Act gives Trump the authority to invade Greenland by military force. Denmark and Greenland have both said they would resist a U.S. invasion with force and have already been moving troops and equipment to the area because of OUR threats. Is that what Floridians want? War with Europe? Our kids going over there to die to make billionaires
